  <input type="range" id="cnAnimScrubber" class="cn-anim-scrubber" min="0" max="0" value="0" step="1" disabled aria-label="Timeline scrubber">
  <select id="cnAnimSpeed" class="cn-anim-speed" disabled aria-label="Playback speed">
  <option value="400">0.5x</option>
  <option value="267">0.75x</option>
  <option value="200" selected>1x</option>
  <option value="133">1.5x</option>
  <option value="100">2x</option>

</div>

  .cn-chart-wrap {

    margin: 0 auto 28px;
  }
  /* The "padding-top hack": height is set as a percentage of THIS box's own
     width (50% = a 2:1 ratio), never measured off the canvas inside it. The
     canvas is pulled out of layout flow with position:absolute so it can
     never feed its own size back into this box's height - that circular
     feedback (canvas height:100% of a parent whose height is in turn
     influenced by the canvas) is exactly what made an earlier version of
     this grow taller forever on every resize check. This is Chart.js's own
     documented pattern for maintainAspectRatio:false containers. */
  .cn-chart-canvas-box {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    padding-top: 50%;
  }

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
// Function to toggle row visibility
function toggleRow(rowId) {
  const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
  if (row) {
    row.style.display = row.style.display === 'none' ? 'table-row' : 'none';
  }
}

// Function to switch between tabs
function cnShowTab(event, targetId) {
  event.preventDefault();
  document.querySelectorAll('.cn-tab-panel').forEach(panel => {
    panel.style.display = 'none';
  });
  const target = document.getElementById(targetId);
  if (target) {
    target.style.display = '';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.cn-tab-link').forEach(link => {
    link.classList.remove('active');
  });
  event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async function() {
  // Define start date and cutoff date
  const startDate = new Date("2024-11-01"); // Replace with your desired start date
  const cutoffDate = new Date("2025-01-31"); // Replace with your desired cutoff date
  const today = new Date();
  const endDate = today <= cutoffDate ? today : cutoffDate;

  // URLs for data
  const dataUrl = "https://www.kameronyork.com/datasets/box-office-data.json";
  const peopleUrl = "https://www.kameronyork.com/datasets/movies.json";
  const detailsUrl = "https://www.kameronyork.com/datasets/movies-details.json";

  let movieData, peopleData, movieDetailsData;

  try {
    const [movieResponse, peopleResponse, detailsResponse] = await Promise.all([fetch(dataUrl), fetch(peopleUrl), fetch(detailsUrl)]);
    if (!movieResponse.ok || !peopleResponse.ok || !detailsResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch data.');
    }
    movieData = await movieResponse.json();
    peopleData = await peopleResponse.json();
    movieDetailsData = await detailsResponse.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching data:", error);
    const animDateLabelOnError = document.getElementById('cnAnimDateLabel');
    if (animDateLabelOnError) {
      animDateLabelOnError.textContent = 'Unable to load chart data.';
    }
    return;
  }

  // Filter peopleData for competition "kamHolly1"
  peopleData = peopleData.filter(person => person.competition === "kamHolly1");

  // Lookup of movie poster/description/release date by IMDB id, used by the
  // Participants tab (poster + description on expand) and the Upcoming Movies tab.
  const detailsById = {};
  movieDetailsData.forEach(detail => {
    detailsById[detail.id] = detail;
  });

  const cumulativeData = {};

  // Filter and sort dates based on start date and end date
  const allDates = Array.from(new Set(movieData.map(entry => entry.Date)))
    .filter(date => {
      const currentDate = new Date(date);
      return currentDate >= startDate && currentDate <= endDate;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a) - new Date(b));

  // Initialize cumulativeData with all dates set to 0 for each person
  for (const person of peopleData) {
    cumulativeData[person.name] = {
      earningsByDate: {},
      totalEarnings: 0,
      movies: [],
    };
    allDates.forEach(date => {
      cumulativeData[person.name].earningsByDate[date] = 0;
    });
  }

  // Sum cumulative earnings per person per day
  for (const person of peopleData) {
    for (const movie of person.movies) {
      const movieEntries = movieData.filter(entry => entry.IMDB_ID === movie.imdb_id);

      let cumulativeSum = 0;
      let movieEarningsByDate = [];

      allDates.forEach(date => {
        const entry = movieEntries.find(e => e.Date === date);
        if (entry) {
          cumulativeSum += parseInt(entry.Daily.replace(/[\$,]/g, '')) || 0;
        }
        cumulativeData[person.name].earningsByDate[date] += cumulativeSum;

        // Track individual movie earnings
        if (cumulativeSum > 0) {
          movieEarningsByDate.push({ date, amount: cumulativeSum });
        }
      });

      // Store movie details
      cumulativeData[person.name].movies.push({
        title: movie.title,
        imdb_id: movie.imdb_id,
        points: movie.points,
        periodToDateTotal: cumulativeSum,
        earnings: movieEarningsByDate
      });
    }
  }

  // Prepare data for line chart
  const colors = [
    'rgb(255, 99, 132)',    // Red
    'rgb(54, 162, 235)',    // Blue
    'rgb(255, 206, 86)',    // Yellow
    'rgb(0, 128, 0)',       // Green
    'rgb(153, 102, 255)',   // Purple
    'rgb(255, 159, 64)',    // Orange
    'rgb(128, 0, 0)',       // Maroon
    'rgb(0, 0, 128)',       // Navy
    'rgb(128, 128, 0)',     // Olive
    'rgb(128, 0, 128)',     // Violet
    'rgb(0, 128, 128)',     // Dark Cyan
    'rgb(220, 20, 60)',     // Crimson
    'rgb(255, 69, 0)',      // Red-Orange
    'rgb(50, 205, 50)',     // Lime Green
    'rgb(70, 130, 180)',    // Steel Blue
    'rgb(255, 140, 0)',     // Dark Orange
    'rgb(75, 192, 192)',    // Teal
    'rgb(154, 205, 50)',    // Yellow-Green
    'rgb(139, 0, 139)',     // Dark Magenta
    'rgb(0, 255, 255)'      // Aqua
  ];

  const sortedNames = Object.keys(cumulativeData).sort();

  // Each dataset's values stay a plain array of numbers (one per day) - the
  // pristine source of truth used for axis-max lookups and to build
  // whatever portion of the line the playback controls decide to reveal. It
  // never gets mutated after this.
  const fullDatasetsData = sortedNames.map(name =>
    allDates.map(date => cumulativeData[name].earningsByDate[date])
  );
  const fullLabels = allDates.slice();
  const totalDays = fullLabels.length;

  // The highest value visible THROUGH a given day, across everyone. Since
  // cumulative earnings only ever go up, the max across everyone AT day N
  // is already the max across everyone through day N.
  const maxByFrame = fullLabels.map((_, dayIndex) => {
    let m = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < fullDatasetsData.length; i++) {
      if (fullDatasetsData[i][dayIndex] > m) m = fullDatasetsData[i][dayIndex];
    }
    return m;
  });

  // Return a deliberately round y-axis ceiling and a matching round tick
  // interval. The ceiling changes only when the data needs the next clean
  // level (for example, $500,000,000 to $600,000,000), never for every raw
  // dollar added to the underlying data.
  function niceAxisBounds(rawMax) {
    if (!(rawMax > 0)) return { max: 1, step: 1 };

    const targetTicks = 6;
    const roughStep = rawMax / targetTicks;
    const exponent = Math.floor(Math.log10(roughStep));
    const magnitude = Math.pow(10, exponent);
    const fraction = roughStep / magnitude;

    let niceFraction;
    if (fraction <= 1) niceFraction = 1;
    else if (fraction <= 2) niceFraction = 2;
    else if (fraction <= 2.5) niceFraction = 2.5;
    else if (fraction <= 5) niceFraction = 5;
    else niceFraction = 10;

    // Dollar ticks must always be whole-dollar values, even in the unlikely
    // event that the chart is still near zero at the start of the season.
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.round(niceFraction * magnitude));
    const max = Math.max(step, Math.ceil(rawMax / step) * step);
    return { max, step };
  }

  // Precompute the round y-axis state required at each completed date. During
  // playback the engine only animates when two neighboring dates require
  // different states; otherwise the y-axis remains completely still.
  const yBoundsByFrame = maxByFrame.map(rawMax =>
    niceAxisBounds(Math.max(1, rawMax || 0))
  );

  // Date-label helpers for the numeric day-index x-axis.
  const MONTH_ABBR = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  function shortTickLabel(dateStr) {
    const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(dateStr));
    if (!match) return String(dateStr);
    const month = MONTH_ABBR[Number(match[2]) - 1] || match[2];
    const day = Number(match[3]);
    return `${month} ${day}`;
  }

  // Fewer anchor ticks on narrow screens. These are stable reference ticks;
  // the currently revealed date is added separately on every render so the
  // x-axis can never appear one or more dates behind the line.
  const xTickTargetCount = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 480) ? 5 : 8;
  const xTickInterval = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(1, totalDays) / xTickTargetCount));
  const lastDayIndex = Math.max(0, totalDays - 1);
  const X_RIGHT_PAD_DAYS = 0.5;
  const xAxisFullMax = Math.max(1, lastDayIndex + X_RIGHT_PAD_DAYS);
  const desiredTickValues = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < totalDays; i += xTickInterval) desiredTickValues.push(i);

  // Values read by the scale callbacks during chart.update('none'). They are
  // updated immediately before each render.
  let liveXEndpointIndex = lastDayIndex;
  let liveYTickStep = 1;

  function visibleXTickValues(axisMax) {
    if (totalDays === 0) return [];

    const endpoint = Math.max(0, Math.min(lastDayIndex, liveXEndpointIndex));
    const visibleSpan = Math.max(1, axisMax);
    const minimumEndpointGap = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.ceil((visibleSpan / xTickTargetCount) * 0.65)
    );

    // Keep the stable anchor ticks, but remove an anchor that is too close to
    // the current endpoint. The endpoint itself is always inserted last, so
    // a final label such as Aug 12 cannot be replaced by Aug 10 or clipped.
    const ticks = desiredTickValues.filter(value =>
      value < endpoint &&
      (value === 0 || endpoint - value > minimumEndpointGap)
    );

    if (!ticks.includes(0)) ticks.unshift(0);
    if (!ticks.includes(endpoint)) ticks.push(endpoint);
    return ticks.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }

  function roundYTickValues(axisMax, requestedStep) {
    let step = Math.max(1, Math.round(requestedStep || 1));
    let tickCount = Math.floor((axisMax + step * 1e-9) / step) + 1;

    // A defensive fallback only: normal niceAxisBounds states stay near six
    // ticks, but this prevents a malformed input from producing hundreds.
    if (tickCount > 12) {
      step = niceAxisBounds(axisMax).step;
      tickCount = Math.floor((axisMax + step * 1e-9) / step) + 1;
    }

    const ticks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < tickCount; i++) {
      ticks.push(i * step);
    }
    return ticks;
  }

  // Builds the visible portion of one line. Completed dates use their real
  // points. A fractional helper point reveals the connecting segment smoothly,
  // but its marker is hidden so a point never appears below its real value and
  // then climbs into place; the real marker appears only at its actual value.
  function buildRevealedPoints(datasetIndex, pos) {
    if (totalDays === 0) return [];

    const values = fullDatasetsData[datasetIndex];
    const clampedPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(pos, lastDayIndex));
    const completedIndex = Math.floor(clampedPos);
    const points = [];

    for (let i = 0; i <= completedIndex; i++) {
      points.push({ x: i, y: values[i], _cnRevealTip: false });
    }

    const fraction = clampedPos - completedIndex;
    if (fraction > 1e-9 && completedIndex < lastDayIndex) {
      const y0 = values[completedIndex];
      const y1 = values[completedIndex + 1];
      points.push({
        x: clampedPos,
        y: y0 + (y1 - y0) * fraction,
        _cnRevealTip: true
      });
    }

    return points;
  }

  // Determine the y-axis state for an exact fractional reveal position. The
  // scale is constant while the required round ceiling is unchanged. When a
  // new ceiling is needed, it expands smoothly from the old round amount to
  // the new round amount over that date-to-date segment. easeOutCubic keeps
  // the expanding axis safely ahead of the line while still settling gently.
  function yAxisStateAtPosition(pos) {
    if (totalDays === 0) return { max: 1, tickStep: 1 };

    const clampedPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(pos, lastDayIndex));
    const fromIndex = Math.floor(clampedPos);
    const toIndex = Math.min(lastDayIndex, fromIndex + 1);
    const fraction = clampedPos - fromIndex;
    const fromBounds = yBoundsByFrame[fromIndex] || niceAxisBounds(1);
    const toBounds = yBoundsByFrame[toIndex] || fromBounds;

    if (toIndex === fromIndex || toBounds.max === fromBounds.max) {
      return { max: fromBounds.max, tickStep: fromBounds.step };
    }

    const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - fraction, 3);
    return {
      max: fromBounds.max + (toBounds.max - fromBounds.max) * eased,
      // Keep the old grid interval throughout the expansion. At the exact
      // new date, any newly appropriate interval takes over; existing round
      // gridlines stay in place and only unneeded intermediate lines vanish.
      tickStep: fromBounds.step
    };
  }

  const initialRevealPos = lastDayIndex;
  const datasets = sortedNames.map((name, index) => ({
    label: name,
    data: buildRevealedPoints(index, initialRevealPos),
    fill: false,
    borderColor: colors[index % colors.length],
    tension: 0.1,
    pointRadius: context => context.raw && context.raw._cnRevealTip ? 0 : 3,
    pointHoverRadius: context => context.raw && context.raw._cnRevealTip ? 0 : 4,
    pointHitRadius: context => context.raw && context.raw._cnRevealTip ? 0 : 1
  }));

  const initialYBounds = totalDays > 0
    ? yBoundsByFrame[lastDayIndex]
    : niceAxisBounds(1);
  liveYTickStep = initialYBounds.step;

  const earningsChartInstance = new Chart(document.getElementById("earningsChart"), {
    type: "line",
    data: { datasets },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      // Playback owns every visual frame. Chart.js animation is disabled so
      // there is only one animation engine and no competing interpolation.
      animation: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: true, position: "top" },
        tooltip: {
          callbacks: {
            title: function(items) {
              if (!items.length) return '';
              const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(lastDayIndex, Math.round(items[0].parsed.x)));
              return fullLabels[idx] ? shortTickLabel(fullLabels[idx]) : '';
            }
          }
        }
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          type: 'linear',
          min: 0,
          max: xAxisFullMax,
          title: { display: true, text: "Date" },
          afterBuildTicks: function(axis) {
            axis.ticks = visibleXTickValues(axis.max)
              .filter(value => value <= axis.max + 1e-9)
              .map(value => ({ value }));
          },
          ticks: {
            autoSkip: false,
            includeBounds: false,
            align: 'inner',
            maxRotation: 0,
            minRotation: 0,
            callback: function(value) {
              const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(lastDayIndex, Math.round(value)));
              return fullLabels[idx] ? shortTickLabel(fullLabels[idx]) : '';
            }
          }
        },
        y: {
          title: { display: true, text: "Cumulative Earnings" },
          min: 0,
          max: initialYBounds.max,
          afterBuildTicks: function(axis) {
            axis.ticks = roundYTickValues(axis.max, liveYTickStep)
              .map(value => ({ value }));
          },
          ticks: {
            autoSkip: false,
            includeBounds: false,
            stepSize: initialYBounds.step,
            callback: value => '$' + Math.round(Number(value)).toLocaleString()
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // ---- Chart playback controls (play/pause, scrub, speed) ----
  // One continuous reveal position drives the line, x-axis, and y-axis. The
  // x-axis always includes the last fully revealed date plus a small endpoint
  // pad, and the y-axis moves only between precomputed round ceiling states.
  (function setupChartPlayback() {
    const playPauseBtn = document.getElementById('cnPlayPauseBtn');
    const scrubber = document.getElementById('cnAnimScrubber');
    const speedSelect = document.getElementById('cnAnimSpeed');
    
    if (!playPauseBtn || !scrubber || !speedSelect) {
      return;
    }

    if (totalDays === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const DEFAULT_MS_PER_DAY = 200;
    const MIN_X_SPAN = 1;
    const END_EPSILON = 1e-7;

    let currentPos = lastDayIndex;
    let isPlaying = false;
    let rafHandle = null;
    let msPerDay = Number(speedSelect.value) || DEFAULT_MS_PER_DAY;
    let playStartTime = 0;
    let playStartPos = 0;

    function clampPosition(pos) {
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(pos) || 0, lastDayIndex));
    }

    function renderFrame(pos) {
      const clampedPos = clampPosition(pos);
      currentPos = clampedPos;
      liveXEndpointIndex = Math.min(
        lastDayIndex,
        Math.floor(clampedPos + END_EPSILON)
      );

      const yState = yAxisStateAtPosition(clampedPos);
      liveYTickStep = yState.tickStep;

      earningsChartInstance.data.datasets.forEach((dataset, index) => {
        dataset.data = buildRevealedPoints(index, clampedPos);
      });

      // The half-day pad keeps the live endpoint and its final date label
      // inside the plot instead of putting them directly on a clipping edge.
      earningsChartInstance.options.scales.x.max = Math.min(
        xAxisFullMax,
        Math.max(MIN_X_SPAN, clampedPos + X_RIGHT_PAD_DAYS)
      );
      earningsChartInstance.options.scales.y.max = yState.max;
      earningsChartInstance.options.scales.y.ticks.stepSize = liveYTickStep;
      earningsChartInstance.update('none');
    }

    function cancelPlayLoop() {
      if (rafHandle !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafHandle);
        rafHandle = null;
      }
    }

    function setInstantFrame(frameIndex) {
      cancelPlayLoop();
      const clampedFrame = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(Math.round(Number(frameIndex) || 0), lastDayIndex)
      );
      renderFrame(clampedFrame);
      scrubber.value = String(clampedFrame);
    }

    function anchorPlayLoop(fromPos) {
      playStartPos = clampPosition(fromPos);
      playStartTime = performance.now();
    }

    function setPlayingUI(playing) {
      isPlaying = playing;
      playPauseBtn.textContent = playing ? '\u23F8' : '\u25B6';
      playPauseBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', playing ? 'Pause animation' : 'Play animation');
    }

    function playbackPositionAt(now) {
      return Math.min(
        lastDayIndex,
        playStartPos + (now - playStartTime) / msPerDay
      );
    }

    function playTick(now) {
      const pos = playbackPositionAt(now);

      renderFrame(pos);
      scrubber.value = String(liveXEndpointIndex);

      if (pos >= lastDayIndex - END_EPSILON) {
        // Land on the exact final integer position so both axes finish on
        // their exact final date and exact round y-axis ceiling.
        renderFrame(lastDayIndex);
        scrubber.value = String(lastDayIndex);
        setPlayingUI(false);
        rafHandle = null;
        return;
      }

      rafHandle = requestAnimationFrame(playTick);
    }

    function startPlayback() {
      if (totalDays < 2) return;

      cancelPlayLoop();
      const startPos = currentPos >= lastDayIndex - END_EPSILON
        ? 0
        : currentPos;

      if (startPos === 0) {
        setInstantFrame(0);
      }

      anchorPlayLoop(startPos);
      setPlayingUI(true);
      rafHandle = requestAnimationFrame(playTick);
    }

    function pausePlayback() {
      // Resolve the exact wall-clock position before stopping. Nothing snaps
      // backward or forward, and Play resumes from the identical visual state.
      currentPos = playbackPositionAt(performance.now());
      cancelPlayLoop();
      renderFrame(currentPos);
      scrubber.value = String(liveXEndpointIndex);
      setPlayingUI(false);
    }

    playPauseBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (isPlaying) pausePlayback();
      else startPlayback();
    });

    scrubber.addEventListener('input', function() {
      if (isPlaying) {
        cancelPlayLoop();
        setPlayingUI(false);
      }
      setInstantFrame(Number(scrubber.value));
    });

    speedSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (isPlaying) {
        const now = performance.now();
        currentPos = playbackPositionAt(now);
        renderFrame(currentPos);
        msPerDay = Number(speedSelect.value) || DEFAULT_MS_PER_DAY;
        anchorPlayLoop(currentPos);
      } else {
        msPerDay = Number(speedSelect.value) || DEFAULT_MS_PER_DAY;
      }
    });


    if (totalDays === 1) {
      scrubber.max = '0';
      setInstantFrame(0);
      playPauseBtn.title = 'Need at least two days of data to animate';
    } else {
      playPauseBtn.disabled = false;
      scrubber.disabled = false;
      scrubber.max = String(lastDayIndex);
      speedSelect.disabled = false;
      setInstantFrame(lastDayIndex);
    }
  })();


  // Sort people by total earnings for table
  const sortedPeople = Object.entries(cumulativeData)
    .map(([personName, data]) => ({
      name: personName,
      totalEarnings: data.movies.reduce((sum, movie) => sum + movie.periodToDateTotal, 0),
      data
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.totalEarnings - a.totalEarnings);

  // Build a single table for all data below the chart
  let tableHtml = `
    <div class="cn-table-scroll">
    <table border="1" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Participant</th>
          <th>Total Earnings</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
  `;

  sortedPeople.forEach(({ name, totalEarnings, data }, index) => {
    const personRowId = `person-row-${index}`;
    tableHtml += `
      <tr class="expandable-row" onclick="toggleRow('${personRowId}')">
        <td>${name}</td>
        <td>$${totalEarnings.toLocaleString()}</td>
      </tr>
      <tr id="${personRowId}" style="display: none;">
        <td colspan="2">
          <table border="1" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Movie</th>
                <th>Period-to-Date Total</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
    `;

    data.movies.forEach((movie, movieIndex) => {
      const movieRowId = `movie-row-${index}-${movieIndex}`;
      const movieDetails = detailsById[movie.imdb_id] || {};

      tableHtml += `
        <tr class="expandable-row" onclick="toggleRow('${movieRowId}')">
          <td>${movie.title}</td>
          <td>$${movie.periodToDateTotal.toLocaleString()}</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="${movieRowId}" style="display: none;">
          <td colspan="2">
            <div class="cn-movie-poster-detail">
              ${movieDetails.image_url ? `<img src="${movieDetails.image_url}" alt="${movie.title}">` : ''}
              <p>${movieDetails.description || 'No description available.'}</p>
            </div>
            <table border="1" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Date</th>
                  <th>Cumulative Earnings</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
      `;
      movie.earnings.forEach(entry => {
        tableHtml += `
          <tr>
            <td>${entry.date}</td>
            <td>$${entry.amount.toLocaleString()}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      tableHtml += `
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;
    });

    tableHtml += `
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });

  tableHtml += `
      </tbody>
    </table>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById("tables-container").innerHTML = tableHtml;

  // Build a per-movie aggregate used by the Movie Metrics and Upcoming Movies tabs.
  // Each movie in this competition is auctioned to exactly one buyer, so there is
  // one aggregate row per movie. A handful of draft picks have no imdb_id yet
  // (still-untitled/unannounced movies) — fall back to a synthetic per-person key
  // so two such movies never collide and silently overwrite one another.
  const movieAggregate = {};
  Object.entries(cumulativeData).forEach(([personName, data]) => {
    data.movies.forEach(movie => {
      const aggregateKey = movie.imdb_id || `no-id::${personName}::${movie.title}`;
      movieAggregate[aggregateKey] = {
        title: movie.title,
        imdb_id: aggregateKey,
        points: movie.points || 0,
        gross: movie.periodToDateTotal,
        owner: personName
      };
    });
  });

  // Rank every drafted movie by its period-to-date gross (1 = highest grossing) —
  // shared by the Movie Metrics and Upcoming Movies tabs
  const grossRanked = Object.values(movieAggregate).slice().sort((a, b) => b.gross - a.gross);
  const rankById = {};
  grossRanked.forEach((movie, index) => {
    rankById[movie.imdb_id] = index + 1;
  });
  const totalDraftedMovies = grossRanked.length;

  // ---- Movie Metrics tab ----
  // One row per movie (Movie grouping)
  const metricsByMovie = Object.values(movieAggregate).map(movie => ({
    name: movie.title,
    imdb_id: movie.imdb_id,
    owner: movie.owner,
    points: movie.points,
    gross: movie.gross,
    dollarsPerPoint: movie.points > 0 ? movie.gross / movie.points : null,
    rank: rankById[movie.imdb_id]
  }));

  // One row per participant, with totals across all of their movies (Participant grouping)
  const participantTotals = {};
  Object.values(movieAggregate).forEach(movie => {
    if (!participantTotals[movie.owner]) {
      participantTotals[movie.owner] = { name: movie.owner, points: 0, gross: 0 };
    }
    participantTotals[movie.owner].points += movie.points;
    participantTotals[movie.owner].gross += movie.gross;
  });

  // Rank participants by their total gross (1 = highest grossing participant)
  const participantGrossRanked = Object.values(participantTotals).slice().sort((a, b) => b.gross - a.gross);
  const participantRankByName = {};
  participantGrossRanked.forEach((participant, index) => {
    participantRankByName[participant.name] = index + 1;
  });

  const metricsByParticipant = Object.values(participantTotals).map(participant => ({
    name: participant.name,
    points: participant.points,
    gross: participant.gross,
    dollarsPerPoint: participant.points > 0 ? participant.gross / participant.points : null,
    rank: participantRankByName[participant.name]
  }));

  const metricsShell = `
    <div class="cn-controls-row">
      <label class="cn-control">
        Group by
        <select id="metricsGroupBy">
          <option value="movie" selected>Movie</option>
          <option value="participant">Participant</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="cn-control">
        Filter by participant
        <select id="metricsOwnerFilter">
          <option value="all">All Participants</option>
          ${sortedNames.map(name => `<option value="${name}">${name}</option>`).join('')}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="cn-control">
        Sort by
        <select id="metricsSortColumn">
          <option value="gross">Total Domestic Gross</option>
          <option value="dollarsPerPoint" selected>Dollars per Point</option>
          <option value="rank">Rank</option>
          <option value="name" id="metricsSortNameOption">Movie</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <button type="button" id="metricsSortDirection" class="cn-direction-btn" data-direction="desc">Descending &#9660;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="cn-table-scroll">
      <table border="1" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
        <thead id="metricsThead"></thead>
        <tbody id="metricsTbody"></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById("metrics-container").innerHTML = metricsShell;

  function renderMetricsTable() {
    const groupBy = document.getElementById('metricsGroupBy').value;
    const ownerFilter = document.getElementById('metricsOwnerFilter').value;
    const sortColumn = document.getElementById('metricsSortColumn').value;
    const directionBtn = document.getElementById('metricsSortDirection');
    const direction = directionBtn.getAttribute('data-direction');
    const isMovieMode = groupBy === 'movie';

    let rows = (isMovieMode ? metricsByMovie : metricsByParticipant).slice();
    if (ownerFilter !== 'all') {
      rows = rows.filter(row => (isMovieMode ? row.owner : row.name) === ownerFilter);
    }

    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      const valA = a[sortColumn];
      const valB = b[sortColumn];

      // Rows with no points spent have a null Dollars per Point (N/A) — always
      // sink those to the bottom regardless of sort direction.
      if (sortColumn === 'dollarsPerPoint') {
        if (valA === null && valB === null) return 0;
        if (valA === null) return 1;
        if (valB === null) return -1;
      }

      let cmp;
      if (typeof valA === 'string') {
        cmp = valA.localeCompare(valB);
      } else {
        cmp = valA - valB;
      }
      return direction === 'asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
    });

    const thead = document.getElementById('metricsThead');
    thead.innerHTML = isMovieMode
      ? `<tr><th>Movie</th><th>Bought By</th><th>Points Spent</th><th>Total Domestic Gross</th><th>Rank</th><th>Dollars per Point</th></tr>`
      : `<tr><th>Participant</th><th>Points Spent</th><th>Total Domestic Gross</th><th>Rank</th><th>Dollars per Point</th></tr>`;

    const tbody = document.getElementById('metricsTbody');
    tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(row => {
      const dollarsPerPointDisplay = row.dollarsPerPoint === null
        ? 'N/A'
        : '$' + Math.round(row.dollarsPerPoint).toLocaleString();

      if (isMovieMode) {
        return `
          <tr>
            <td>${row.name}</td>
            <td>${row.owner}</td>
            <td>${row.points.toLocaleString()}</td>
            <td>$${row.gross.toLocaleString()}</td>
            <td>${row.rank}</td>
            <td>${dollarsPerPointDisplay}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }
      return `
        <tr>
          <td>${row.name}</td>
          <td>${row.points.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>$${row.gross.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${row.rank}</td>
          <td>${dollarsPerPointDisplay}</td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }

  document.getElementById('metricsGroupBy').addEventListener('change', function() {
    document.getElementById('metricsSortNameOption').textContent = this.value === 'movie' ? 'Movie' : 'Participant';
    renderMetricsTable();
  });
  document.getElementById('metricsOwnerFilter').addEventListener('change', renderMetricsTable);
  document.getElementById('metricsSortColumn').addEventListener('change', renderMetricsTable);
  document.getElementById('metricsSortDirection').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const isDesc = this.getAttribute('data-direction') === 'desc';
    const newDirection = isDesc ? 'asc' : 'desc';
    this.setAttribute('data-direction', newDirection);
    this.innerHTML = newDirection === 'asc' ? 'Ascending &#9650;' : 'Descending &#9660;';
    renderMetricsTable();
  });

  renderMetricsTable();

  // ---- Upcoming Movies tab ----
  // Parse a release date value as a local calendar date (no time component), so
  // comparisons against "today" aren't thrown off by UTC-vs-local parsing quirks.
  // Handles a plain "YYYY-MM-DD" prefix (even if trailing time/timezone text is
  // attached to it) and falls back to native Date parsing for any other format
  // (ISO datetime, "Month D, YYYY", timestamps, etc.) so a format we didn't
  // anticipate degrades to "unknown" instead of silently breaking every row.
  function parseReleaseDate(dateValue) {
    if (!dateValue && dateValue !== 0) return null;

    const isoMatch = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(dateValue).trim());
    if (isoMatch) {
      const year = Number(isoMatch[1]);
      const month = Number(isoMatch[2]);
      const day = Number(isoMatch[3]);
      const parsed = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return parsed;
    }

    const fallback = new Date(dateValue);
    if (!isNaN(fallback.getTime())) {
      return new Date(fallback.getFullYear(), fallback.getMonth(), fallback.getDate());
    }

    return null;
  }

  // Movies release on or before today are considered released: greyed out, and
  // excluded when "Upcoming Only" is checked.
  const todayDateOnly = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate());

  const farFutureDate = new Date(8640000000000000); // used to push unknown release dates to the end when sorting

  const upcomingRows = Object.values(movieAggregate).map(movie => {
    const details = detailsById[movie.imdb_id] || {};
    const releaseDateObj = parseReleaseDate(details.release_date);
    const isReleased = releaseDateObj !== null && releaseDateObj <= todayDateOnly;
    return {
      title: movie.title,
      imdb_id: movie.imdb_id,
      owner: movie.owner,
      image_url: details.image_url || '',
      description: details.description || '',
      release_date: details.release_date || null,
      gross: movie.gross,
      rank: rankById[movie.imdb_id],
      isReleased
    };
  });

  // Sort by release date ASC, then title ASC
  upcomingRows.sort((a, b) => {
    const dateA = parseReleaseDate(a.release_date) || farFutureDate;
    const dateB = parseReleaseDate(b.release_date) || farFutureDate;
    const dateDiff = dateA - dateB;
    if (dateDiff !== 0) return dateDiff;
    return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
  });

  const upcomingShell = `
    <div class="cn-controls-row">
      <label class="cn-control cn-checkbox-control">
        <input type="checkbox" id="upcomingOnlyFilter">
        <span>Upcoming Only</span>
      </label>
    </div>
    <div class="cn-table-scroll">
      <table border="1" class="cn-upcoming-table" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Poster</th>
            <th>Title &amp; Description</th>
            <th>Release Date</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="upcomingTbody"></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById("upcoming-container").innerHTML = upcomingShell;

  function renderUpcomingRows() {
    const upcomingOnly = document.getElementById('upcomingOnlyFilter').checked;
    const rows = upcomingOnly ? upcomingRows.filter(row => !row.isReleased) : upcomingRows;

    const tbody = document.getElementById('upcomingTbody');
    tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(row => {
      const rowClass = row.isReleased ? 'cn-movie-old-row' : '';
      const captionClass = row.isReleased ? 'cn-movie-old-row cn-movie-caption-row' : 'cn-movie-caption-row';

      return `
        <tr class="${rowClass}">
          <td>${row.image_url ? `<img src="${row.image_url}" alt="${row.title}">` : ''}</td>
          <td><strong>${row.title}</strong><br>${row.description || ''}</td>
          <td>${row.release_date || 'Unknown'}</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="${captionClass}">
          <td colspan="3">Total Domestic Gross: $${row.gross.toLocaleString()} &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp; Rank: #${row.rank} of ${totalDraftedMovies} drafted movies &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp; Drafted by: ${row.owner}</td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }

  document.getElementById('upcomingOnlyFilter').addEventListener('change', renderUpcomingRows);

  renderUpcomingRows();
});
</script>
